messages:
amanda_sre: Seeing a sharp increase in 5xx for eu-south egress to provider-2 around 12:02UTC. GPU pools are healthy, but egress paths are timing out and causing retries. Investigating routing asymmetry.
ops-bot: [ALERT] egress-error-rate > 3% on cluster eu-south (12:03 UTC) — ticket INC-8341 created.
javier_net: Any idea if this is BGP or peering on provider side?
amanda_sre: Initial BGP session flaps to provider-2, some routes are preferring a congested peering link. No proxy CPU/IO issues.
elliot_sre: Propose shifting low-priority traffic to eu-west2 and keeping high-priority customers on local GPUs with cache-only responses. Can do weighted BGP reweighting and update route-map.
nina_finops: Heads-up: cross-region egress to eu-west2 will increase cost ~2.5x for the shifted traffic. Approve for 60m?
amanda_sre: Approve for mitigation window. We can limit to burstable queues and model-server non-critical routes.
javier_net: On it — applying temporary route-map to prefer eu-west2 via IX-A for 30m. Command: ```bgp route-map SET-PREF permit 10
 set local-preference 200
 set as-path prepend 64512 64512
```
elliot_sre: Starting traffic migration now. Gradually drain half of best-effort queue over 4m. Will monitor 5xx.
ops-bot: [UPDATE] 5xx rate dropped from 3.4% -> 0.9% after initial weighting (12:10 UTC).
support-lead: Drafting support note. CX triage — which customers are impacted and do we need personalized outreach?
claire_cs: A handful of mid-market customers in EU reported latency spikes. I'll pull the list from the alert and flag enterprise accounts.
amanda_sre: Short-term statuspage copy (please review): "We are mitigating increased egress errors in eu-south by routing select traffic to eu-west2. Some requests may see increased latency or cost-based fallback responses. ETA for full routing stabilization: ~45–70 minutes. We will provide follow-ups"
support-lead: Edit: add 'no data loss, model inference continues'. Also adding contact for priority escalations.
nina_finops: Please include cost advisory for customers on usage-based plans — they should expect higher egress billing for impacted requests.
amanda_sre: Noted. Posting to statuspage now.
javier_net: Monitoring BGP session stability. If flaps recur, we'll failover to IX-B and expand route-map.
elliot_sre: Observability: token-level latency shows additional 120–240ms p95 for shifted traffic. p50 unaffected.
ops-bot: [METRIC] egress-err-rate=0.7% p95-latency-shift=220ms (12:23 UTC).
amanda_sre: Mitigation holding. Plan for rollback: if err-rate <1% and p95 <300ms for 15m, we'll leave routes for another hour then gradually revert.
claire_cs: Sent customer note to affected accounts and created escalation channel for priority cases. :thumbsup:
support-lead: Support handoff to night-shift at 18:00 local — leaving runbook steps in the channel.
javier_net: Added fallback commands and contact for IX ops in runbook.
ops-bot: [RESOLVE] incident moved to MONITORING state (12:39 UTC). Follow-up action: open postmortem if route flaps >2 in 24h.
amanda_sre: Thanks team. We'll keep monitoring and file a brief postmortem if we see recurring AS path instability. Closing thread in 2h if stable. :raised_hands:
